subtasks.title: Fix cmd_list default status from empty string to 'all'
subtasks.rationale: Only one file (src/cli.py) needs changes: signature change in cmd_list and a corresponding call-site update in main(). Both changes are in the same file and tightly coupled, so a single task avoids unnecessary overhead.

overall_rationale: 1 subtask — the entire fix touches only src/cli.py (signature + call site). Merging into one task avoids cross-file coordination overhead and matches the '<=2 files → 1 task' rule.
